Who we are

The Band

Drivin' Blind was formed in 2025 by Tory Foster and is based in Lee County, Alabama. We play outlaw country with a little Southern rock and rock mixed in.

Our inspirations run from Waylon Jennings, Hank Williams Sr. and Jr., and Charlie Daniels to ZZ Top's Billy Gibbons, Lynyrd Skynyrd, and Stevie Ray Vaughan.

We usually play as a duo ★ Available as a full band

Tory Foster

Bass & professional joker

A lifelong Alabama native, except for his years serving in the military. Tory is a Desert Storm and Mogadishu, Somalia veteran.

He started playing music at 14 and joined his first band right after. Now he's back to music after an extended break.

Taylor Jenkins

Guitar & vocals

A lifelong Alabama native, Taylor has been playing music since he was a child and has played in bands as a guitarist or singer for most of his life.

He has played several venues in Nashville with a variety of artists.
